text:
ITEM 1 | Pale white, soft, crumbly mass with rough, granular surface and small loose fragments scattered at the edge; holds a mounded shape, slightly moist, matte with no sheen; occupies roughly 15% of plate area, about 8 cm across and 2-3 cm tall; sits on the right side of the plate beside the broccoli and greens | 130

ITEM 2 | Bright green florets with dark green tops and some lighter stems, firm, slightly glossy and moist-looking, with visible bumpy floret texture; a cluster about 6 cm across and 2-3 cm tall, lying just above the pale mass and against the greens | 60

ITEM 3 | Dark green leafy greens (spinach-like leaves) with darker veins, flat and limp, slightly wilted, matte; spread across the left-center of the plate in a footprint about 7 cm by 6 cm, under and around the other vegetables, roughly 1 cm thick | 35

ITEM 4 | Thin pale green curved strips of cucumber-like skin with light green flesh showing at the cut edges, slightly translucent, arranged in a fan-shaped wedge about 4 cm long and 1 cm thick at the upper left, resting on the leaves | 15

ITEM 5 | Thin orange shreds, bright orange with slightly glossy surface, matted into a tangled pile about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1 cm tall, sitting on top of the leafy greens at the left | 20

ITEM 6 | Small halved cherry tomato, bright red-orange skin with paler pulp and seeds visible at the cut face, glossy and firm, about 2 cm across, sitting at the lower left edge of the greens | 10
